description: Calculate peptide reconstitution: concentration, draw volume, syringe units and doses per vial. Forward mode: dose_mcg. Reverse mode: pass dose_units to back-solve the dose. Returns precision (parallax) warnings, syringe overflow checks and concentration advisories. Research use only.

dose_units.description: Syringe units drawn (reverse mode; back-solves the dose).

peptide.description: Peptide id or name (e.g. "bpc-157"). Optional context provider; use list_peptides to discover.

syringe_type.description: Syringe grading: U-100 (1 ml = 100 units) or U-40 (1 ml = 40 units).

vial_mg.description: Peptide amount in the vial, mg.

name: calc_reconstitution
title: Peptide reconstitution calculator
